articles.title: UK sanctions Huobi and ruble stablecoin issuer in crackdown on Russia crypto networks
articles.snippet: Britain applied banking-style sanctions to crypto exchanges for the first time, requiring U.K. financial firms to freeze funds and trace transactions.

articles.title: At $322 billion, the stablecoin market value exceeds the FX reserves of 95 nations
articles.snippet: The amount of dollars and other fiat currencies held by users outside traditional banking channels now exceeds the official FX reserves of 95 nations.

articles.title: With Central Bank’s Blessing, Georgia Taps Tether for 'Official' Stablecoin
articles.snippet: Tether plans to issue a stablecoin in Georgia with support from the country’s government, marking a new frontier for the crypto giant.
